frames.title: Lesson 170 · Concessive structures (Much as I admire…) — production and review

body: **Foco:** Concessive structures (Much as I admire…) — produção e revisão.
**Pronúncia:** Organização da informação pela entonação.
**22 palavras novas** (negociações).
**Texto do dia:** biografia.

blocks.t: **Objetivo de comunicação (C1):** eu consigo produzir uma biografia com estruturas concessivas e revisar a forma (as, though, despite, however).

body: Esta aula treina **escrever frases claras e corretas (IELTS Writing, TOEFL Writing)**.

blocks.t: Toque em 🔊, ouça e repita cada palavra. Depois tente adivinhar o sentido.

blocks.name: Sofia Lund (fictional diplomat)
paras: **Young as she was**, Sofia Lund became chief negotiator at thirty-four. **Much as** colleagues doubted her, she earned their respect. **Though** she had no formal training in law, she mastered the details. **Try as they might**, rivals could not ignore her preparation.

**Despite** many setbacks, she never lost patience. **However complex** the issue, she began with listening. **Strange as it may seem**, her greatest success was a treaty that nobody wanted at first. “**Hard as** compromise is,” she says, “it is cheaper than conflict.”

items.q: Sofia became chief negotiator at fifty.
She had no formal training in law.
She says compromise is more costly than conflict.

blocks.body: Revise: a oração concessiva **não** usa *but* na principal; *despite* nunca leva *of*; em *adj + as* o adjetivo vem **no início**.
✗ *Although she was tired, but she worked.* ✓ *Although she was tired, she worked.*

items.s: ___ as she was, Sofia became chief negotiator. (Young)
___ many setbacks, she never lost patience. (Despite)
However ___ the issue, she began with listening. (complex)
___ as compromise is, it is cheaper than conflict. (Hard)

blocks.title: Match the word to its meaning

body: **Against all odds** — Contra todas as probabilidades
**Win hearts and minds** — Conquistar corações e mentes
**Earn one’s stripes** — Conquistar seu espaço
**Prove the doubters wrong** — Provar que os céticos estão errados
**Keep a cool head** — Manter a cabeça fria
**Do one’s homework** — Fazer a lição de casa
**Play the long game** — Jogar a longo prazo
**Come out on top** — Sair por cima
**And the hardest treaty?** — E o tratado mais difícil?
**Young as you were, how did you win respect?** — Jovem como você era, como conquistou respeito?
**However complex it was, we began by listening.** — Por mais complexo que fosse, começamos ouvindo.

blocks.title: Interview
lines: Young as you were, how did you win respect?
Jovem como você era, como conquistou respeito?
By preparing. Much as they doubted me, they could not fault my notes.
Preparando-me. Por mais que duvidassem, não puderam criticar minhas notas.

items.note: Ênfase intencional: a palavra mais importante da frase recebe o acento mais forte e a nota mais alta, para marcar contraste ou correção.
words: It was the POLICY, not the person.
We need MORE time, not more money.

prompts.model: Young as I was, I took the job.
However hard it is, I will try.

blocks.task: Write a 7-sentence mini-biography of a person using at least five different concessive structures.
blocks.model: Poor as his family was, Marco went to university. Much as his teachers admired him, they could not pay his fees. Though he worked nights, he never missed a class. Despite exhaustion, he finished first. However hard the exams were, he stayed calm. Strange as it may seem, he thanks his difficulties. Try as I might, I cannot imagine a harder path.

body: Treine esta habilidade com o formato de tarefas curtas das provas (TOEFL/IELTS).
Leia o enunciado primeiro e procure as palavras-chave.
Use exemplos reais da vida dos alunos e peça frases próprias.
Corrija o erro mais frequente da aula em grupo, sem expor o aluno.
Retome o conteúdo na aula seguinte com um exercício curto.
